comment: Increment-3 mutation ledger. Each entry names a module, a unique source substring and its replacement. The set is checked in so the next sweep is a re-run rather than a re-invention, and so a shrinking survivor list is visible in a diff (increment-2 review, mutation-methodology adjudication, amendment 2). Operators are declared in operators[]. Modules covered are every module this increment touched, with a per-module floor of 8 (amendment 1). Run with tools/mutation_sweep.py in the tester's scratchpad; the oracle is the whole suite with -x, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and a git checkout in the finally.
operators: guard-clause drop: `if X and Y` -> `if X`; `if X` -> `if False`
negation drop or insertion: `not X` -> `X`, `is None` -> `is not None`
normalization drop: sorted(), set(), tuple(), dict()
rung / branch reorder (R27 ladder, R30 priority order)
literal substitution (string constants, rounding modes, quanta)
control-flow swap: continue <-> break, early return removal
